sectors.ai: Buy selective US-listed AI infrastructure and optical names (COHR, LITE, CRWV) on the AI capex supercycle, but stay underweight Indonesian tech (ID -0.49%) where liquidity is thin and earnings momentum weak. Rotate from laggard NBIS into ORCL for enterprise AI backlog visibility. Use 9988 (Alibaba) as a China AI proxy only for tactical swings, not core.

themes: US AI data-center power demand is structurally re-rating independent power producers and solar-plus-storage names, creating durable outperformance versus Indonesian utilities tied to slower PLN dispat

sectors.ai: US-listed renewables names are leading on policy momentum and AI-driven power demand, while Indonesian exposure lags on domestic regulatory friction. sectors.ai: Buy selective mid-cap FMCG names with confirmed volume breakouts (JELI, IATA, BACH) while avoiding large-cap laggards; the sector's mild aggregate gain masks strong rotational momentum into smaller consumer plays. Position for 2-4 week continuation as US-listed peers (+0.46%) confirm demand, but trim into any 15%+ single-day spikes to lock gains.
